decisions.decision: Build a fresh standalone RideX project under the specified root; do not inherit previous projects, databases or environment configuration.
Use a dedicated local PostgreSQL database for foundation work; do not connect to legacy or remote databases during foundation.
Backend is authoritative for business state, permissions, fares, payment outcomes and final trip/booking state; clients cannot access the business database directly.
decisions.source: Baseline packages and recorded RideX decisions

decisions.decision: RideX product/backend business logic remains deterministic and AI-free.
GLOBAL Admin has authorized global dataset access; STATE and CITY Admins are restricted to their assigned geography; enforcement is server-side.
Customer App, Driver App, Admin App, Web Admin and Super Admin Control are separate interfaces; Gateway and public website are separate components.
A Super Admin private key must not be embedded or exposed as plaintext in a distributed mobile application.
assignedMobileNumber, deviceName, deviceId and gatewayId are separate identities and must not be substituted for one another.
OTP request client contract uses actorType, actorId and exact purposeCode; requestType/delivery selection are resolved by backend configuration rather than a client-controlled separate requestType.
OTP expires after 5 minutes, allows 5 wrong attempts, has a 1-minute resend interval, carries remaining wrong attempts forward on resend, and alerts after the fifth wrong attempt.
Exact cooldown duration after the configured maximum resend count is not finalized; source defaults must not be treated as final policy.

Clients may continue read-only ok:false compatibility handling; do not mass-rewrite response bodies. Dynamic/idempotency replay responses and runtime caller compatibility remain in final verification.

decisions.decision: Locked canonical mapping: Booking Type RIDE/GOODS; Passenger uses CITY_RIDE (Full Ride, no passenger count), SHARING_RIDE (Share Ride, passenger count), INTERCITY_RIDE (Connection Ride, passenger count); Event availability uses serviceType EVENT and rideType EVENT_RIDE, while persisted booking uses bookingType RIDE, rideType CITY_RIDE, serviceSubtype EVENT_RIDE with passenger count; Parcel uses GOODS/PARCEL with CITY_LOGISTIC_PARCEL or QUICK_LOGISTIC_PARCEL; Goods uses GOODS/GOODS with SMALL/MEDIUM/LARGE. Passenger/Event use the approved passenger vehicle categories; Parcel/Goods use CARGO_DELIVERY. Backend is authoritative for eligibility. Runtime/UI/DB verification remains pending.

The 67 baseline security requirements are decomposed into 134 testable control scenarios with expected result and evidence requirements. Scenarios are test-design only and remain NOT_RUN until all four package A-Z implementations finish.

Threat model maps 18 threats across 11 trust zones and links them to security requirements/control cases. This is static design traceability only; penetration/security runtime tests are deferred until all four packages are implemented.
